title: Homology identifies homotopy morphisms
statement: Let C be a category with topology J, R a sheaf of commutative rings, U an object of C, and L,I arbitrary cochain complexes of R-modules. Let S be the section complex at U of the Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex], with its specified product projections pi, and res the termwise restriction to the slice C/U. Then, assume restriction to C/U preserves zero morphisms. Let e be an equivalence from degree-zero cycles of S to chain maps res(L) → res(I), and assume its components are exactly the specified product projections evaluated on the included cycles at U, for every degree and every object of (C/U)^op. Let q be the quotient to the homotopy category. There exists an equivalence a from H^0(S) to morphisms q(res(L)) → q(res(I)) satisfying a(homologyπ(z)) = q(e(z)) for every cycle z. The canonical component condition on e is required.

proof.text: The assumed projection formula implies additivity of e: compare chain-map components, then compare the underlying presheaf maps at each W. Cycle inclusion and each evaluated projection preserve addition. Package e as an additive map.

Use the localized null-homotopy criterion and Mathlib quotient_map_eq_zero_iff to identify the kernel of q.map composed with e with the range of toCycles from degree -1. Independently, homologyIsCokernel and exactness of cokernels in abelian groups identify the kernel of homologyπ with that same range.

Apply the two kernel criteria to z-z′. Additivity of e, q and homologyπ shows homologyπ(z)=homologyπ(z′) if and only if q(e(z))=q(e(z′)). Homologyπ is surjective because it is an epimorphism of abelian groups. Define the descended function using a representative of each class; the fiber criterion proves its representative formula and injectivity. Fullness of q and surjectivity of e prove surjectivity. Equiv.ofBijective supplies the required equivalence.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero Equation 0A8Y; X2 formalized additivity and quotient descent and isolated the degree -1 boundary criterion.

theorem localizedHomComplex_homology_aux
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max u v}) (U : C)
    (L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v}
      ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hzero : Functor.PreservesZeroMorphisms
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v}
        ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R) U))
    (e : let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
      let H := homComplex (R := R) L I
      let S := ((SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
        forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H
      letI := hzero
      let res := (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
      S.cycles 0 ≃ (res.obj L ⟶ res.obj I)) :
    let R₀ := (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u v} RingCat.{max u v})).obj R
    let H := homComplex (R := R) L I
    let π := Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
      (homComplex_exists.{u, v, max u v, max u v} (J := J) (R := R)))
    let S := ((SheafOfModules.forget R₀ ⋙ PresheafOfModules.evaluation R₀.obj (op U) ⋙
      forget₂ (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R₀.obj.obj (op U))) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj H
    letI := hzero
    let res : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} R₀) ℤ ⥤
        CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R₀.over U)) ℤ :=
      (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{max u v} R₀ U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient
      (SheafOfModules.{max u v} (R₀.over U)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    (∀ (z : S.cycles 0) (p : ℤ) (W : (Over U)ᵒᵖ),
      ((e z).f p).val.app W =
        (((π L I 0 p p (add_zero p)).val.app (op U)) (S.iCycles 0 z)).app W) →
    ∃ a : S.homology 0 ≃ (q.obj (res.obj L) ⟶ q.obj (res.obj I)),
      ∀ z : S.cycles 0, a (S.homologyπ 0 z) = q.map (e z)
